scripts.clean:deps: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/node_modules website/node_modules packages/*/node_modules bun.lockb frontend/bun.lock backend/bun.lock 2>/dev/null || true && echo '🧹 清理完成'
scripts.reinstall: bun run clean:deps && bun install && echo '✅ 依赖已清理并重新安装'
scripts.build: bun run env:sync:dev && bun run --filter @yiveno/design-tokens typecheck && bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n fe,be,web -c cyan,green,yellow "bun run build:fe:compile" "bun run build:be" "bun run build:web:compile"
scripts.build:prod: bun run env:sync:prod && bun run env:check:prod && bun run --filter @yiveno/design-tokens typecheck && bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n fe,be,web -c cyan,green,yellow "bun run build:fe:prod:compile" "bun run build:be" "bun run build:web:prod:compile"
scripts.watch:stream: bun run env:sync:dev && bunx concurrently --names fe,be,web --prefix-colors cyan,green,yellow "bun run watch:fe" "bun run dev:be" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.doc:check:all: bun run doc:check && bun run doc:check:consistency
scripts.lint: bun run format && bun run eslint && bun run stylelint
scripts.lint:check: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n eslint,stylelint -c blue,magenta "bun run eslint:check" "bun run stylelint:check"
scripts.eslint: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n fe,be,web -c cyan,green,yellow "bun run --cwd frontend eslint" "bun run --cwd backend eslint" "bun run --cwd website eslint"
scripts.eslint:check: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n fe,be,web -c cyan,green,yellow "bun run --cwd frontend eslint:check" "bun run --cwd backend eslint:check" "bun run --cwd website eslint:check"
scripts.stylelint: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n fe,web -c cyan,yellow "bun run --cwd frontend stylelint" "bun run --cwd website stylelint"
scripts.stylelint:check: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n fe,web -c cyan,yellow "bun run --cwd frontend stylelint:check" "bun run --cwd website stylelint:check"
scripts.test:run: bunx concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n fe,be -c cyan,green "bun run test:fe:run" "bun run test:be"
scripts.clean: bun run --cwd frontend clean && bun run --cwd backend clean
